statement: New authoring-contract Quests cannot begin or checkpoint their first measured attempt until a durable independent design-review finding predates that attempt, while existing Quests remain readable.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Existing version-1 and unversioned Quests remain readable; only newly scaffolded version-2 Quests acquire the pre-first-attempt review obligation.
The qualifying finding must have kind design-review, a stable non-empty subagent evidence identity, and an event position before the first measured attempt.
